  2) Redwood: create a dedicated POC workspace and provision trial quota; share onboarding checklist and minimal IAM/KMS requirements (attached)
  3) Schedule kickoff: 30-minute setup call to walk through keys, VPC peering basics (I’m proposing Tue 9/28 10am PT)

If that all looks good I’ll provision the workspace and send the calendar invite. If the 9/28 slot doesn’t work, tell me a couple of alternatives.
